summary: Phase 4b/4c Meta + Microsoft Ads push backend tests — 16/16 passed. Verified preflight endpoints, auth gates, draft 404/422 validation, end-to-end happy path 409 GatewayNotEligible with channel-specific friendly error messages, cross-channel 400 validation, pushes list regression, and /api/products?limit=5 regression (seeder hardening).
critical_code_review_comments: ai_ad_creative.py is 790 lines — consider splitting push handlers into a dedicated router module (push_handlers.py) and keeping the generator separate for maintainability.
_resolve_subject_for_push duplicates subject-lookup logic that could be shared with the google push handler — minor DRY opportunity.
Meta/Microsoft preflight catch broad Exception and stringify it into the 'reason' field — fine for UX but consider logging the stack at WARN so silent eligibility regressions surface in admin logs.
seed_data_creation: Four ad_creative_drafts were generated through the real LLM-backed /admin/ad-creative/generate endpoint during happy-path + cross-channel validation tests. No cleanup performed — drafts are tied to the test admin user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter347_ads_push_meta_microsoft.py covers all Phase 4b/4c push endpoints + regressions. Re-runnable. Verified: (a) preflights return eligible:false with channel-specific friendly reasons (no integration_credentials row), (b) 401 without admin, (c) 404 for unknown draft_id, (d) 422 when daily_budget_cents<500, (e) 409 GatewayNotEligible with 'Meta App Review / ads_management' wording for meta and 'Microsoft Ads' wording for microsoft, (f) 400 cross-channel mismatch with 'google_search' / 'meta' in detail, (g) /api/admin/ad-creative/pushes still 200, (h) /api/products?limit=5 still 200.
